### It’s So Easy To Drift
Author: Christine Caine
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-16-2021.html
Passage: Hebrews 2:1
Points:
- Spiritual drifting occurs gradually and subtly rather than through a sudden, deliberate choice.
- Overfamiliarity with the faith can cause believers to lose awe and take salvation for granted.
- Believers must continually check their spiritual markers against God's Word to stay on course.
- Jesus understands human frailty and provides the help believers need to avoid drifting away.

### So Great a Salvation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/so-great-salvation
Passage: Hebrews 2:1-3
Points:
- Christ's supreme identity means believers must pay the closest possible attention to His gospel.
- The message delivered by Christ carries even greater accountability than the law mediated by angels.
- Neglecting so immense a salvation carries severe and inescapable spiritual consequences.
- God uses sober biblical warnings to keep believers vigilant and anchored in their faith.
